736:t_1:486.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So... we fight with the strength of all of us.」

736:t_1:488.en:
$$カレン$$
「All right, now that our resolve is settled, let's hear from $n too.」

736:t_1:489.en:
$$シン$$
「What do you want to do once there's peace?」

736:t_1:492.en:
$$クラン$$
「You, who stubbornly refused no matter how much everyone around you urged you to!?」

736:t_1:493.en:
$$アルト$$
「What brought on the change of heart?」

736:t_1:494.en:
$$甲児$$
「Is it a makeover to go with you ditching the quiet type act?」

736:t_1:496.en:
$n
(I don't need to chase after Mom's likeness anymore...)

736:t_1:497.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is there anything else? Something like a dream for the future.」

736:t_1:498.en:
$n
「I wrote $$ビーストハンター$$ on my school career survey, but...」

736:t_1:499.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What are you going to do in the hunter's off-season?」

736:t_1:500.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think you'd make a good test pilot now, $n. Your piloting technique has grown enough, too.」

736:t_1:501.en:
$$ランド$$
「No, no...! Your attention to detail and your stubbornness are made for repair work!」

736:t_1:502.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Your field combat skills work in the city too... How about being a stylish private eye with me? I'll pay a decent salary.」

736:t_1:504.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Trained in heart by $$ランド$$, in skill by $$セツコ$$, and in body by $$クロウ$$, you should be able to aim for the heights, $n.」

736:t_1:505.en:
$n
「Heart, skill, body... Maybe I'll try for yokozuna.」

736:t_1:506.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your growth, $n, is also reflected in the simulation results.」

736:t_1:507.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your overall record is 224 wins and 387 losses.」

736:t_1:509.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You were a total greenhorn at first. But looking only at your record since the $$時獄戦役$$, it's 144 wins and 145 losses.」

736:t_1:513.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You really might become a good test pilot.」

736:t_1:514.en:
$$ランド$$
「No, no...! He's a hot-blooded repairman!」

736:t_1:515.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wrong. He's a hard-boiled private eye.」

736:t_1:516.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly! This is no time to be saying things like that!」

736:t_1:517.en:
$n
「You're right... And here we are, right before the decisive battle with the $$御使い$$s...」

736:t_1:518.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's not what I mean, $n... Do you think you can graduate the way things are now!?」

736:t_1:520.en:
$$宗介$$
「She's right, $n. Our battle will go on even after we've restored peace.」

736:t_1:521.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's bad. We swore to everyone in Class 2-4 that we'd all graduate together, and yet...」

736:t_1:523.en:
$n
「Let's make sure we come back alive! Having won the future!」

736:t_1:525.en:
$n
「What will you do when the fighting is over, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

736:t_1:527.en:
$n
「But what you said before the decisive battle with the $$アンチスパイラル$$, about wanting to go back someday to a life of wearing glasses... that only half came true, didn't it...」

736:t_1:528.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then this time, $n, I'd like you to be the one to take my glasses off...」

736:t_1:529.en:
$n
「Should I ask AG to adjust it back to the old pilot suit?」

736:t_1:531.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh! Could it be you want to make a woman say something embarrassing out loud!? You and your quiet-type act!」

736:t_1:532.en:
$n
「...As I thought, I'm still the quiet type...」

736:t_1:534.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Fine, $n. After the fighting is over, I'll give you plenty of lessons.」

736:t_1:536.en:
$n
「I don't want to repeat a year either. I want to graduate with everyone!」

736:t_1:538.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Looks like a rough road ahead...)

736:t_1:539.en:
$n
「Let's go, Miss $$スズネ$$. To keep our promise to everyone, too.」

736:t_1:541.en:
$n
(Thank you, Miss $$スズネ$$... I'm really happy I got to be your partner...)

736:t_3:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「A temporary power of $$シンカ$$...! Is this the humans' petty struggling!」

736:t_3:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's useless! Power like this won't work on us!」

736:t_3:8.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「My beloved sister broke the $$ギアス$$ laid on her through sheer strength of will!」

736:t_3:9.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「If willpower can break a $$ギアス$$, then conversely, it should be possible to strengthen one with willpower!」

736:t_3:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「A nobody like you has no way of beating an $$御使い$$ with mental strength!」

736:t_3:12.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Stop this pointless effort! Do you intend to throw your own life away!」

736:t_3:13.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Exactly! I was prepared to die from the start!」

736:t_3:15.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I suppose you can't believe it, immortals that you are.」

736:t_3:16.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「That is the very weakness of the $$御使い$$s! You don't know the weight of life... or its power!」

736:t_3:17.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「You, who have obtained eternity, cannot win against the heart of a human who has resolved to die!」

736:t_3:19.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「You obtained eternity, and lost the brilliance of a single moment... the meaning of life!」

736:t_3:20.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Now, take it! My final $$ギアス$$... my own life!!」

736:t_2:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's not it, $$ドクトリン$$.」
